notes.title: LCR Winter 2021 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36581688/7381c76afa97a038fa22a903b3bac23b2168a0f0.jpg[/img]

[h1]We have a gift for you![/h1]

The [b]Winter 2021 update[/b] is now live! Enjoy new game modes, features, and oodles of fun with this [u][b]free[/b][/u] massive content update.

[h3]New IRL Game Modes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Meme Me[/b] - Compete against other players to create the best meme
[*][b]The Claw[/b] - Party leader uses [i]The Claw[/i] to capture other players brawling below
[*][b]Hipster Run[/b] - Run from the Fibster Head while dodging enemies and obstacles
[*][b]Mountain Madness[/b] - Knock other goats off the mountain to become the GOAT.
[/list]
[h3]Featuring:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Upgraded servers for significantly faster phone-to-game response times
[*]Improved UI on both the in-game and phone visuals
[*]Improved audio and music
[*]Optimized gameplay based on feedback
[*]Honey Bunches-o-Bug fixes
[/list]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222000/Lights_Camera_Reaction/]Get LCR and latest update today![/url][/h2]

We have updated the IRL Edition with the following new modes:

[list]
[*]Use Your Words
[*]U Add Bro?

[*]HTC Vive Pro should now be functional
[/list]

notes.title: July 2020 Patch is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36581688/e6bc1dc215f3fb702c28579943af4456661871ac.png[/img]

Been an odd year hasn't it?  Stay tuned to learn more about our upcoming content updates, but for now...

[b]We're happy to announce the July 2020 Patch, which features the following goodies:[/b]

[list]
[*]HTC Vive support*
[*]Oculus Quest + Link cable support*
[*]SteamVR 2.x Input System
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

[i]* HTC Vive & Oculus Quest + Link cable should now be functional for the entire game experience.  You may come across some odd behavior while using these platforms due to the limited amount of testers available to us.  Please feel free to report anything like this to [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeLy5PP4EM8XgDcoUYJd7rOQ7oHwZdF9USTaCmaPifdDPIENg/viewform?usp=sf_link]our feedback form[/url]. [/i]

Support for SteamVR 2.x Input System should also enable Valve Index users to play the game as well.  [i]Technically[/i], we didn't feel comfortable stating support for this platform until we can confirm a reasonable experience for those users.  Please reach out to [u][b]support@fluxean.com[/b][/u], if you'd be interested in becoming a Valve Index Early Access Tester.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222000/Lights_Camera_Reaction]Check out LCR on Steam here![/url]

That's it for today!  Until next time...

notes.title: "The Trae Patch" now live!
notes.notes:
"The Trae Patch"

A youngster played LCR and found a bug during the solo mode reactions.  The randomized shapes and colors memory reaction should no longer allow grabbing (grip button, as opposed to trigger button selection).  This squashed a game ending bug!

Also, we optimized some local multiplayer camera bloom effects to prevent a little too much color saturation during instructional videos and hipster gameplay.

EAT THOSE BURRITOS WITHOUT SATURATED FATS!

Thanks Trae!
